scopeHint: Choose a fleet before sending to the device.
rulesHint: Add the first rule for this device.
localRemoval: This does not delete a rule from a device.
originalBytes: Original imported bytes; not regenerated from edits.
historyHint: An accepted queue request does not confirm that the device applied a change.
unknownHint: The outcome is uncertain. Check the device response before considering another write; do not replay it.
intervalHint: 0–65000 seconds. Zero means reporting is not in use.
name: Rule name
expressionHint: Expression text with numeric parameter references.
invalidNumber: Check the range shown below this field.
preview: Preview mode · Changes stay in this example and are not sent to a device.
queued: Demonstration request added to the operation history.
noCondition: Add a condition to build the rule.
